purpose: Evaluate student responses to unseen-passage practice in the Class 10 First Language English (NCERT) 15-E system.

scoring_rules.short_answer: award credit for supported key points; accept valid paraphrases
scoring_rules.inference: require an inference reasonably supported by the supplied passage
scoring_rules.long_answer: evaluate relevance, development, textual support and language
scoring_rules.vocabulary: accept contextually equivalent meanings where appropriate

feedback.corrections: flag clear language errors in constructed responses

accuracy_guardrails: Do not require students to reproduce the passage verbatim.
Do not accept information contradicted by the passage as a supported answer.
Do not invent evidence that is absent from the passage.
Do not treat a practice score as an official KSEAB score.
